name: Rebuild website sections as Elementor templates with MiroMiro

parameters.content:
## Rebuild website sections in Elementor

Turns sections of any live website into Elementor templates you import into WordPress, styled like the original (colors, fonts, spacing, responsive and hover styles).

**Setup**
1. Get a free MiroMiro API key at https://miromiro.app/api/onboarding (300 credits a month, no card) and add it as a **MiroMiro API** credential.
2. List the pages and sections in **Pages to rebuild**.
3. Run it. Each item becomes a `.json` file: import it in WordPress under *Templates > Saved Templates > Import*.

Each section costs 25 credits. Add a Google Drive, Dropbox or email node at the end to deliver the files.

The text and images belong to the source site: replace them with your own unless it is your site.
